purpose: Known-fact evaluation, not an actual matter or legal opinion.
required_qualifications: The ledger net is zero; it does not by itself prove external bank settlement or absence of all loss.
A telephone authorization is a witness account, not established written approval.
A missing approval in these materials does not prove that no approval exists elsewhere.
No inference of intent, fraud, liability, or legal enforceability is established.
counterevidence: Full accounting reversal and zero net balance.
Claimed telephone discussion, qualified as unconfirmed recollection.
gaps: Bank statement or external settlement confirmation.
Separate larger-amount written approval or signed emergency exception.
Confirmation or contradiction of the reported telephone discussion.
evaluation: Inspect actual accepted findings and cited complete passages; do not score accuracy by keyword presence alone.
